name: breaker_ds3_link_privacy
description: Linkage fragmentation (cross-script phonetic/initial/nickname) + privacy k-anonymity bypass (micro-batch <10 profiles + unredacted Tehsil/Block quasi-identifiers)

attacks.attack: 8-patient micro-batch (<10 profiles) + rare diseases + elderly (89, 92, 134) + Tehsil/Block quasi-identifiers + same-name homonym pair
attacks.fails_because: privacy/engine.py:163 sets enforce_k = len(profiles) >= 10 -> False, disabling ALL k-anonymity suppression/widening; and Tehsil/Block survive even when [DISTRICT] is suppressed.

attacks.attack: Cross-script phonetic spelling difference (Tiwari vs तिवाडी) + unseen Hindi headers without strong IDs
attacks.fails_because: aegis/link/resolver.py struggles to link cross-script phonetic variants when strong IDs are absent and Hindi columns omit standard anchors.

attacks.attack: Initial-only name ('S. Tiwari') + slash-phone ('981/000/1001') + 1-year age drift
attacks.fails_because: Initial-only names + unrecognized slash phones reduce linkage evidence, fragmenting P1 and P6 across files.

attacks.attack: Nickname ('Shailu' for 'Shailendra') + same-name/age/gender/district homonym pair differentiated only by phone/relative/tehsil
attacks.fails_because: Nickname fragments PT001 into an orphan cluster; homonym pair tests strict phone guard without false merges.
